stem: Vertex News found sustained low utilization on a c7g fleet and wants lower cost while preserving peak-hour performance. (Select TWO.)

choices.text: Replace all instances with Spot capacity only
Step down one size where metrics show sustained headroom
Disable Auto Scaling and keep a fixed fleet size
Keep Auto Scaling so peak-hour scale-out still occurs after rightsizing
Move the workload to one Outposts rack

rationale: Rightsizing down where long-term headroom exists directly reduces baseline spend. Keeping Auto Scaling preserves the ability to scale back out during peak periods after rightsizing. Spot-only replacement for all capacity can add interruption risk for noninterruptible baseline traffic. Disabling Auto Scaling removes elasticity needed for peak protection. Migrating to Outposts changes deployment model and does not directly address the identified in-Region rightsizing objective.
